name: 04-sparse-technical
description: Thin input: two low findings, no evidence attached to one, technical audience. Confidence should not come back high on this.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options
findings.plain_english: Browsers may guess file types, which can turn harmless files into executable code.

findings.title: Server software version disclosed
findings.plain_english: The site advertises what software it runs, which helps attackers pick exploits.
findings.remediation: Remove or genericize Server and X-Powered-By headers at the web server or CDN.
